title: Ambiguous: "make it better, fast and secure" with a mid-run change request
description: A vague business request. The requirements agent refuses to guess on high-severity ambiguities and asks the human; answers are merged and the agent re-runs. Midway, the stakeholder changes the requirement (add expiry, drop rate limiting) and the engine re-plans only the invalidated part of the graph.
requirementText: Make the link shortener better for our marketing team. It should be fast and secure, scale well, and give us some reporting on how campaigns are doing.

events.description: Marketing: campaign links must expire automatically, and rate limiting is handled by the API gateway so drop it for now
events.appendText: Change request: links created for a campaign must expire automatically; rate limiting will be provided by the API gateway.

answers.AMB-SECURITY: rate limit link creation per client and block dangerous URLs
answers.AMB-REPORTING: daily click counts per link with top referrers, as a JSON API
